label: MC420L 10G SFP+ media converter (multi-gig copper)
description: 1x 1G/2.5G/5G/10GBASE-T RJ45 + 1x SFP+ (DIP switch selects 1G/10G or 2.5G optical).
notes: Datasheet: RF45 auto-negotiation 1G/2.5G/5G/10G, SFP+ with 'easy switching between 1G/10G and 2.5G optical port modes', 802.3ab/bz/an/z/ae/aq/cb, Cat6 55 m / Cat6a 100 m at 10GBASE-T, 9V 0.6A, 5.26 W. Cage speedCaps exclude 5000 because 5GBASE-T is copper-only on this unit. Distinct from planet/XT-705A already catalogued (fixed 10G) because of the multi-gig copper and the 2.5G optical mode.

label: TFC-1000MGA 100/1000BASE-T to SFP media converter
description: 1x 10/100/1000 RJ45 + 1x mini-GBIC accepting 100BASE-FX and gigabit optics.
notes: Spec sheet: 'Ports: 1 x 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit port, 1 x 100/1000Base-SX/LX Mini-GBIC slot', DIP switches 'Fiber (forced/auto-negotiation), LLCF (enable/disable)', 5V DC 1A. Adds the 100BASE-FX-in-cage case the TP-Link MC220L does not support. v1.0R discontinued, replaced by v2.0R with the same ports. First TRENDnet media converter in the catalogue (TEG-S350/TEG-S380/TPL-430AP already present).

label: Cat6a 24-port shielded feed-through patch panel, 1U
description: Passive 24-port Cat6a coupler panel, 10GBASE-T and PoE++ rated.
notes: FS 118904 / C6AP-S24FT1U: 24-port 1RU shielded feed-through, 10GBase-T and PoE++ rated, cable management bar included. Categorised as splitter to match the existing passive-panel precedent (fs/FHD-1U-PP-24LC) - flagged in notes rather than inventing a category, because vendor/category counts are asserted by doc-catalog-counts. This is the catalogue's first copper patch panel; before it, every patch panel was fibre.
